driver.request: For each run, resolve request_ref in requests, replace base_ref with the full object from bases under key base, and submit the resulting JSON to the corresponding binary.
driver.new_engine_compatibility: Skip driver registration of item 13937 if already registered by the engine.
driver.without_drink: Remove item 4696 on-use registration NewSimpleStatActive(4696) and exclude it from the explicit onUse list.
driver.stock_vs_without_stormshroud_3pc: Run the identical job with stock then with the sole 3: {23863} entry removed from the Stormshroud Armor item set. Pair DPS by iteration.
driver.metric: DPS. Each driver's diff and se are paired against the first job in the request. For the isolated set bonus, difference is stock minus disabled and paired_standard_error is its standard error. stdev is the across-fights standard deviation of total DPS.

priorityList.notes: Rapid Fire at range: from the pull, or like the other cooldowns after the first 5 s.
Start of the fight, before the first weave: get to my spot without losing an Auto Shot.

actions.notes: In melee with the GCD about to come up: wait for it, so the melee key goes out before I leave.
In melee with Strider Kick about to come up: wait for it.
I swung since my last Auto Shot: walk out to my spot and shoot.
Auto Shot went off since my last swing: walk in and swing.
Walk to my spot, looking again every reaction time. Stop while my Auto Shot's windup is close or running, and react to each shot before walking on.
